TransactionStatus.description:
The high-level outcome of a transaction.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `APPROVED` | Transaction was approved and completed successfully. |
| `PROCESSING` | Transaction is still being processed. |
| `DECLINED` | Transaction was declined (e.g., by issuer, risk, validation). |
| `ERROR` | Transaction failed due to a system or technical error. |
| `CANCELLED` | Transaction was cancelled by the user or merchant. |
| `UNKNOWN` | Transaction outcome is unknown or indeterminate. |

StatusReasonCode.description:
The full set of status-reason codes a transaction can carry, as `reason_code` on error responses and as `status.reasonCode`/`status.reason` on transaction status responses. Codes are grouped by domain below.

### System
Internal platform, infrastructure, or configuration issues.

| Code | State | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SYSTEM/SUCCESSFUL` | APPROVED | Transaction Approved | The transaction was successfully processed and approved. |
| `SYSTEM/PARTIAL_APPROVAL` | APPROVED | Partial Approval | The transaction was approved for a lower amount than requested (partial approval). |
| `SYSTEM/ZERO_AMOUNT_AUTHORIZATION_ONLY` | APPROVED | Zero-Amount Authorization Only | The authorization succeeded for zero-amount verification only; the card is valid but nothing was charged. |
| `SYSTEM/PROCESSING` | PROCESSING | Transaction Processing | Transaction is currently being processed by the system. |
| `SYSTEM/CREATED` | PROCESSING | Transaction Created | A new transaction has been initiated in the system and is awaiting customer input to provide the required details in order to proceed. |
| `SYSTEM/TIMEOUT` | ERROR | System Timeout | The system timed out while processing the transaction. |
| `SYSTEM/INTERNAL_ERROR` | ERROR | Internal System Error | An unexpected internal system error occurred. |
| `SYSTEM/UNKNOWN` | UNKNOWN | Unmapped Status | The received status could not be mapped to a known internal state. |

### Payer account

| Code | State | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/TRANSACTION_REJECTED_AS_INVALID` | DECLINED | Invalid Transaction | The transaction was rejected as invalid by the payment provider managing the payer’s account. |

| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/CARD_ACTIVATION_REQUIRED` | DECLINED | Card Activation Required | The card has not been activated. The issuer requires an activation step (e.g. PIN transaction or ATM use) before it can be used. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/CARD_LIFECYCLE_DECLINE` | DECLINED | Card Lifecycle Decline | The issuer declined for an unspecified card lifecycle reason (e.g. expiry, replacement, migration, or closure) without indicating which. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/INVALID_AMOUNT` | DECLINED | Invalid Amount | The issuer rejected the transaction because the amount value is invalid or unacceptable (e.g. negative or zero). |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/EXCEEDS_CUMULATIVE_AMOUNT_LIMIT` | DECLINED | Exceeds Cumulative Amount Limit | The cumulative transaction amount over a defined period (e.g. daily or monthly) has exceeded the cardholder's limit. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/INVALID_INSTALLMENT_PLAN` | DECLINED | Invalid Installment Plan | The selected installment plan is invalid, unsupported, or not permitted for this card or transaction type. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/INVALID_INSTALLMENT_COUNT` | DECLINED | Invalid Installment Count | The requested number of installment payments is invalid or outside the allowed range. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/RELATED_TRANSACTION_LOCKED` | DECLINED | Related Transaction Locked | The referenced transaction or issuer record is currently locked and cannot be modified (e.g. an update is in progress or restricted by issuer policy). |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/CASH_BACK_NOT_ALLOWED` | DECLINED | Cash Back Not Allowed | The issuer declined the cash-back request because the card or transaction type permits purchase transactions only. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/CANCELLED` | CANCELLED | Transaction Cancelled | Transaction was cancelled before completion. |

| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/CONTACT_PAYER_PAYMENT_PROVIDER` | DECLINED | Contact Payer Payment Provider | The customer must contact their payment provider that manages their account (e.g., issuing bank, wallet provider) to proceed with the transaction. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/CONTACT_PAYER_PAYMENT_PROVIDER/REFER_TO_CARD_ISSUER` | DECLINED | Refer to Card Issuer | The card issuer requests the cardholder to contact them directly. |

| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/NO_CHECKING_ACCOUNT` | DECLINED | No Checking Account | The holder does not have a checking account associated with the card. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/NO_SAVINGS_ACCOUNT` | DECLINED | No Savings Account | The holder does not have a savings account associated with the card. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/INCORRECT_PIN` | DECLINED | Incorrect PIN | The PIN entered is incorrect. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/PIN_TRIES_EXCEEDED` | DECLINED | PIN Tries Exceeded | The allowable number of PIN entry attempts has been exceeded. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/PIN_MANAGEMENT_DENIED` | ERROR | PIN Management Denied | The issuer declined a request to change or unblock the card PIN. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/PIN_REQUIRED` | DECLINED | PIN Required by Payer’s Payment Provider | The payer’s payment provider requires a PIN (online or offline) to authorize this transaction, but no PIN was provided. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/PIN_VERIFICATION_ERROR` | ERROR | PIN Verification Error | The issuing bank could not validate your PIN. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/OFFLINE_PIN_REQUIRED` | DECLINED | Offline PIN Required by Payer’s Payment Provider | The payer’s payment provider requires an offline PIN for this transaction. The provided authentication method does not meet this requirement. |

| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/RESTRICTED_CARD` | DECLINED | Restricted Card | The card is restricted and cannot be used for this transaction or region. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/DOMESTIC_DEBIT_NOT_ALLOWED` | DECLINED | Domestic Debit Not Allowed | The debit card is not permitted for domestic transactions due to issuer, scheme, or regulatory restrictions (common in markets such as India or Russia where certain cards are valid only for international or specific channels). |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/INVALID_DESTINATION_ACCOUNT` | DECLINED | Invalid Destination Account | The destination ("to") account is invalid, non-existent, or restricted, so the transfer could not be completed. |
| `PAYER_ACCOUNT/INVALID_SOURCE_ACCOUNT` | DECLINED | Invalid Source Account | The source ("from") funding account is invalid, missing, or not supported for this transaction. |

### Risk
Internal fraud and risk decisions enforced by the platform.

| Code | State | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RISK/DECLINED` | DECLINED | Risk Declined | The transaction was declined by the risk engine. |
| `RISK/BLOCK_LISTED` | DECLINED | Blocklisted Transaction | The transaction was rejected because one or more of its attributes match a value that has been blocklisted by SmartRetry’s risk management system. |
| `RISK/VELOCITY_BLOCKED` | DECLINED | Velocity Limit Exceeded | The transaction was blocked due to velocity checks enforced by SmartRetry’s risk management system or the merchant’s configured rules, indicating that activity thresholds (e.g., frequency or volume) have been exceeded. |
| `RISK/NO_ELIGIBLE_MERCHANT_ACCOUNTS` | DECLINED | No Eligible Merchant Accounts | No candidate merchant accounts remained after filtering by the payment providers allowed under risk policy. |

| `PROCESSOR/NO_ACCOUNT_RECORD` | DECLINED | No Account Record | No account record found by the verifying party. |
| `PROCESSOR/TIMEOUT` | ERROR | Payment Processor Timeout | The payment processor did not respond within the expected time. |

x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/INVALID_EFFECTIVE_DATE/CAR: Invalid or Incorrect Card Effective Date: The card effective ("valid from") date is invalid, or the card is not yet active.

x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/INVALID_AMOUNT: Invalid Amount: The issuer rejected the transaction because the amount value is invalid or unacceptable (e.g. negative or zero).
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/EXCEEDS_CUMULATIVE_AMOUNT_: Exceeds Cumulative Amount Limit: The cumulative transaction amount over a defined period (e.g. daily or monthly) has exceeded the cardholder's limit.

x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/INVALID_INSTALLMENT_COUNT: Invalid Installment Count: The requested number of installment payments is invalid or outside the allowed range.

x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/CANCELLED: Transaction Cancelled: Transaction was cancelled before completion.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: Insufficient Funds: The holder account has insufficient funds to complete the purchase.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/LOST_INSTRUMENT: Lost Instrument: The payment instrument has been reported as lost.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/LOST_INSTRUMENT/LOST_CARD: Lost Card: The payment card has been reported as lost by the cardholder or the issuing bank.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/STOLEN_INSTRUMENT: Stolen Instrument: The payment instrument has been reported as stolen.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/STOLEN_INSTRUMENT/STOLEN_C: Stolen Card: The payment card has been reported as stolen by the cardholder or the issuing bank.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/INSTRUMENT_NOT_AVAILABLE: Payment Instrument Unavailable: The payer’s account payment provider declined the transaction because the payment instrument is not available for use (e.g., inactive, suspended, or revoked).

x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/DO_NOT_HONOR: Do Not Honor: The issuer declined the transaction without providing a specific reason.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/PICKUP_CARD: Pick Up Card: The issuer requests that the card be retained.

x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/NO_CHECKING_ACCOUNT: No Checking Account: The holder does not have a checking account associated with the card.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/NO_SAVINGS_ACCOUNT: No Savings Account: The holder does not have a savings account associated with the card.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/INCORRECT_PIN: Incorrect PIN: The PIN entered is incorrect.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/PIN_TRIES_EXCEEDED: PIN Tries Exceeded: The allowable number of PIN entry attempts has been exceeded.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/PIN_MANAGEMENT_DENIED: PIN Management Denied: The issuer declined a request to change or unblock the card PIN.

x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/PIN_VERIFICATION_ERROR: PIN Verification Error: The issuing bank could not validate your PIN.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/OFFLINE_PIN_REQUIRED: Offline PIN Required by Payer’s Payment Provider: The payer’s payment provider requires an offline PIN for this transaction. The provided authentication method does not meet this requirement.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/EXCEEDS_AMOUNT_LIMIT: Exceeds Amount Limit: The transaction amount exceeds the cardholder's approval limit.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/EXCEEDS_WITHDRAWAL_FREQUEN: Exceeds Withdrawal Frequency Limit: The cardholder has exceeded the allowed number of withdrawals.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/RESTRICTED_CARD: Restricted Card: The card is restricted and cannot be used for this transaction or region.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/DOMESTIC_DEBIT_NOT_ALLOWED: Domestic Debit Not Allowed: The debit card is not permitted for domestic transactions due to issuer, scheme, or regulatory restrictions (common in markets such as India or Russia where certain cards are valid only for international or specific channels).
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/INVALID_DESTINATION_ACCOUN: Invalid Destination Account: The destination ("to") account is invalid, non-existent, or restricted, so the transfer could not be completed.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/INVALID_SOURCE_ACCOUNT: Invalid Source Account: The source ("from") funding account is invalid, missing, or not supported for this transaction.

x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/CARD_BLOCKED: Card Blocked: The card is blocked, possibly due to first use or security restrictions.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/STOP_PAYMENT_ORDER: Stop Payment Order: A stop payment order has been placed on this transaction.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYER_ACCOUNT/AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED: Authorization Revoked: All authorizations for this account have been revoked.

x-enumDescriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD/INELIGIBLE_FOR_RESUBMISSI: Ineligible for Resubmission: This transaction is not eligible for resubmission.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD/DECLINED: Payment Method Declined: The payment method was declined.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD/NOT_ALLOWED_AT_TERMINAL: Not Allowed at Terminal: This transaction type is not allowed at this terminal.

x-enumDescriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD/AML_VIOLATION: AML Violation: The transaction does not fulfill anti-money laundering requirements.

x-enumDescriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD/VIOLATION_OF_LAW: Violation of Law: The transaction cannot be completed due to a legal violation.
x-enumDescriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD/SURCHARGE_NOT_ALLOWED: Surcharge Not Allowed: The surcharge amount is not permitted on this card or by scheme rules (common in US debit/acquirer environments). Visa codes: B1, B2.
